def normalize_record(record: dict, prefix="tool-") -> dict:
    result = record.copy()
    result["id"] = prefix + record["id"].strip()
    result["name"] = record["name"].strip().lower()
    return result

import asyncio

async def run_concurrent(calls):
    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(call()) for call in calls]
    return await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
